key.name: edit-mode
key.description: Flipped by the "Manage Widgets" pill in the Control Center. When true the desktop enters edit mode: the dock and open windows hide and the widget picker appears.

key.name: widgets
key.description: JSON array of placed widget instances. Each entry is {id, type, variant, monitor, xRel, yRel} where xRel/yRel are the widget's top-left as a fraction of its monitor's work area.

key.name: weather-auto-location
key.summary: Detect the weather location from the public IP address
key.description: When true the weather widgets geolocate by IP and ignore the manual latitude/longitude/name keys below.

key.name: weather-latitude
key.description: Used when weather-auto-location is off, and as the fallback when IP geolocation fails at boot. Default: Savannah, Georgia.
